props.text: When the price rose above 72,000, I immediately wrote in my group that there was no point in opening short positions because we'd at least reach 76-78! There's a market structure that depends on geometry and mathematics

Continues bullish range structure thesis from Aug 29 (dismissal of shorts, BTC consolidation 76-87K); targets 76-78K as minimum continuation from 72K breakout; aligns with large BTC long (58.4 entry) positioning.
